source.labelling_caveat: simplicial_complexes.SurfaceOfGenus(6) returns a differently labelled complex on each Sage process. The facets_sha256 below is the labelling this record was computed from and will not generally be reproduced; the cohomology ring is unaffected, being a topological invariant, but the cocycle representatives belong to that labelling. regenerate_sage.jl checks isomorphism invariants for these entries instead of the hash.
